services.desc: Before racing games had online multiplayer, realistic physics, licensed vehicles, and cinematic cutscenes, there was Excitebike - a game that gave you a dirt bike, a track full of ramps, and one very important life lesson: Released for the Nintendo Entertainment System in the 1980s, Excitebike became one of those classic games that instantly made sense the moment you picked up the controller. Go fast, hit jumps, avoid wrecks, and try not to launch your rider face-first into the dirt. Simple idea. Endless fun.
